name: Sinbar
author: d3vw
description: A keyboard-first sing-box monitor with outbound and Tailscale controls for the Omarchy bar.

barWidget.description: Monitor sing-box traffic, switch outbounds, inspect Tailscale peers, connections, and logs.

schema.label: Config path
schema.description: TOML file containing host, port, secret, TLS, and interval_ms.

schema.label: Node layout
schema.description: Display nodes as a list or a compact three-column grid.

schema.label: Tailscale SSH username
schema.description: Username on the remote device. Root is common for servers; change it when the remote account differs.

schema.label: TUI command
schema.description: Optional command opened in a terminal with a right click. Leave blank to disable.
